text:
mona_subramanian: Quick FYI 1 1 we have an onsite interview scheduled for Diego Morales next Fri 09:00-12:30 PT. He requested a wheelchair-accessible room, a screen-reader friendly loaner laptop, and reimbursement in MXN. Can we confirm availability before I send the final invite?

diego_morales: Hiring manager note 1 the loop is 2x tech interviews + 1x manager chat. Screen-reader support + big-font display preferred. Also Diego asked if he can plug in his own external SSD for test data.

carmen_ops: We can reserve Accessible Room D (ground floor) and provide a loaner MacBook with VoiceOver configured or a Windows laptop with NVDA. Which OS do we prefer? Also do you need a ramp at the main entrance signed?

it_support: We can provision a Win11 loaner with NVDA, enlarged font preset, and a locked-down temp account. If Diego wants to use an external SSD we'll sanitize and mount it read-only. Do we need to preload the 800MB eval dataset?

mona_subramanian: Please preload the dataset and disable cloud sync. Also confirm we can provide a tactile keyboard overlay and a wired headset with inline mic.

recruiter_bot: (automated) Diego Morales 1 travel: Mexico City, prefers MXN reimbursement. Visa: NA. Email: d.morales@example.mx. Requested a mobility assistance note for the front desk.

carmen_ops: Locked Accessible Room D 08:30-13:00 for setup/teardown. Front desk will print badge with "Interviews" and note mobility assist. Ramp signage confirmed. Will add 2 hours parking validation code: "ACC-77".

it_support: Imaging started. Will install NVDA, set font scale to 150%, increase cursor size, and preload dataset to local path C:\\eval. Need candidate consent to mount SSD. Also confirm whether internet should be restricted; default is restricted outbound only.

mona_subramanian: Restrict outbound net. Candidate consent will be collected beforehand. Dietary: gluten-free + no sesame. Single boxed lunch requested.

diego_morales: Please add a short agenda into the invite and include transit instructions for nearest metro stop. Also can we book a 1-night courtesy hotel if arrival is before midnight?

carmen_ops: Yes courtesy hotel for arrivals before 11:30pm. I'll include transit details and the hotel note. Agenda snippet to paste: 
```
08:30 1 setup + accessibility check
09:00 1 Intro / Hiring manager (Diego)
09:30 1 Tech interview A
10:30 1 Break + buffer
10:45 1 Tech interview B
11:45 1 Lunch + recruiter wrap
12:15 1 Next steps
```

it_support: Small note: bring candidate's charger (USB-C or MagSafe adapter) and we will provide a sanitized wired headset. We'll leave a sticky note at the desk 10m prior to arrival.

mona_subramanian: I'll draft the SSD consent form, confirm MXN reimbursement policy link, and request the dataset mounting waiver from Diego. I'll also add interpreter options in the invite in case he needs live captioning.

recruiter_bot: (automated) Calendar invite created and sent to d.morales@example.mx, Diego, Mona, Carmen, IT Support. Invite ID: 1887654321-dmlo.

carmen_ops: Catering ordered: gluten-free boxed lunch, allergy card attached. Front desk told to escort candidate to Accessible Room D. Closing loop unless anything else pops up.

mona_subramanian: Thanks team. I'll follow up if candidate requests additional assistive tech. :pray:
